title: The Page Reload
description:
## Fix the Bug: The Page Reload

The form has a submit handler that should display a greeting. Instead, hitting Submit causes the page to reload (you’ll see the iframe flicker), state resets, and the greeting never appears.

### Symptoms
- Click Submit — page reloads
- The `#result` greeting never sticks
- Inputs lose their value

### Your Task
Make Submit display the greeting **without** reloading the page.

> **Think about it:** HTML forms have a default browser behavior — they submit to the server and navigate away. React doesn’t override that for you. Which method on the event object cancels the default action?
